daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Ranking
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate the 30-day price change percentage for each stock. Use a CTE to compute the opening price 30 days ago and the most recent closing price for each ticker. Then use ROW_NUMBER() windowed function to rank stocks by momentum (highest to lowest % gain) within each month. Return the top 10 gainers and bottom 10 losers for the most recent complete month in the dataset. Include ticker, price change %, rank, and the calculation date.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Aggregation
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (CSV format). Clean the dataset by: (1) removing rows with missing crash location coordinates, (2) standardising the Crash_Type column to title case and removing leading/trailing whitespace, (3) converting datetime columns to proper datetime objects, (4) filtering for crashes in the last 5 years only. Then aggregate the cleaned data to calculate total crashes, fatalities, and severity distribution by Local Government Area (LGA). Export results to a new CSV file with LGA, total_crashes, total_fatalities, and severity_breakdown columns. Document any data quality issues found.

daily_quests.title: AFL Match Performance Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build an end-to-end pipeline: (1) In Python, load AFL match results dataset (Kaggle), clean team names (fix case inconsistencies), and calculate each team's win-loss record, average points scored, and average points conceded for the last 2 completed seasons. Save to a SQLite database table named 'team_stats'. (2) In SQL, query this table to identify the top 5 most improved teams (by win percentage increase year-on-year) and the top 3 defensive teams (lowest average points conceded). (3) Return a final result showing team name, previous season win %, current season win %, improvement %, and defensive ranking. Document your Python data transformations in comments.
